SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('hora', CASE WHEN agendado_para IS NULL THEN 'a combinar' ELSE to_char(agendado_para,'HH24:MI') END, 'nome', COALESCE(nome_cliente, numero_cliente), 'assunto', COALESCE(assunto,''), 'status', status) ORDER BY agendado_para NULLS LAST), '[]'::json)
   FROM giulia_reunioes
   WHERE status IN ('agendada','confirmada')
     AND agendado_para::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date) AS reunioes_hoje,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'nome', COALESCE(nome_cliente, numero_cliente), 'assunto', COALESCE(assunto,'')) ORDER BY criada_em), '[]'::json)
   FROM giulia_reunioes
   WHERE status = 'pendente_aprovacao_thiago') AS reunioes_pendentes,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('nome', COALESCE(nome, numero), 'tipo', COALESCE(tipo_projeto,'?'), 'cidade', COALESCE(localizacao,'?')) ORDER BY criado_em DESC), '[]'::json)
   FROM giulia_leads
   WHERE criado_em > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS leads_novos,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'titulo', titulo, 'prazo', CASE WHEN prazo IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_char(prazo,'DD/MM') END, 'atrasada', (prazo IS NOT NULL AND prazo < (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date)) ORDER BY (prazo IS NULL), prazo), '[]'::json)
   FROM giulia_tarefas WHERE status='pendente') AS tarefas,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('hora', to_char(disparar_em,'HH24:MI'), 'descricao', descricao) ORDER BY disparar_em), '[]'::json)
   FROM giulia_lembretes
   WHERE status='pendente' AND disparar_em::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date) AS lembretes_hoje,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(tarefa ORDER BY id), '[]'::json)
   FROM giulia_rotina
   WHERE ativa AND dia_semana = EXTRACT(DOW FROM (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'))::INT) AS rotina_hoje,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'para', COALESCE(destinatario_nome, destinatario_numero)) ORDER BY criado_em), '[]'::json)
   FROM giulia_envios_pendentes
   WHERE status='aguardando_confirmacao' AND expira_em > NOW()) AS envios_pendentes;
